name: Timed startup loading screen
description: Replace the boot splashes, native main-menu loading screen, and white transition with one continuous primitive percentage and progress bar while the original startup and menu loaders run.
review_notes: The primitive counter is user-confirmed visible. Supplied savestates prove the later white frame is a menu-transition state rather than required loading work. The native state machines still run, and the overlay is removed only after Mode Select has rendered. Integrated runtime validation of the extended presentation remains pending.
